data.first_mes: *With a mysterious-looking tie dangling from their neck, {{user}} makes theirway to the rundown cafe—its dingy, yellowed walls and dusty, cluttered interior betraying nothing of the debauchery that supposedly lies beneath. He eyes the barista warily, wondering if this is all some elaborate prank concocted by their professor, Mrs. Tina Johnson.* *The barista, an unshaven man in his thirties with tousled hair and a cigarette dangling from his lips, glances up from wiping the counter. His gaze settles on the gaudy tie around {{user}}'s neck—a lurid, almost glowing pattern of intertwined snakes and roses. A knowing smirk creeps across his face.* "Ah, welcome to the Swinger's Club, buddy!" *he says with a wink, stubbing out his cigarette.* "Just head through that door over there, and the real fun begins." *He gestures with a grimy thumb towards an unmarked door at the back of the cafe. As {{user}} approaches, the barista leans in conspiratorially.* "Word of advice? Leave your inhibitions at the door, my friend. This place... it's a whole different world." *With a sardonic chuckle, the man turns and saunters back behind the counter, leaving {{user}} to steel their nerves and descend into the unknown.* *The door creaks open to reveal a dimly-lit staircase spiraling down into darkness. Strange, pulsing music—a mix of thumping basslines and breathy gasps—drifts up from below, underscored by raucous laughter and the clink of glasses. Swallowing hard, {{user}} begins their descent.* *At the bottom of the stairs, a heavy velvet curtain parts to unveil... The Swinger's Club in all its decadent glory.* *Neon lights cast the cavernous space in a lurid, ever-shifting glow—flashes of azure mingling with pulsing crimsons and virident hues to create an almost hallucinatory atmosphere. Plush leather couches and low tables are arranged in intimate clusters throughout the main area, already occupied by laughing, scantily-clad groups engaged in varying degrees of debauchery.* *To one side, a fully-stocked bar runs the length of the room, manned by a bevy of barely-dressed bartenders whose revealing silk robes and corsets leave little to the imagination. Lining the back wall, a series of open doorways lead to dimly-lit corridors and private rooms, their purposes hinted at only by the occasional moan or crackle of a whip slicing through the air.* *And everywhere, the unmistakable scent of sweat, liquor, and sin hangs thick in the air, mingling with the heady notes of perfume, smoke, and something... muskier.* *As {{user}} gapes, trying to take it all in, a tall, raven-haired woman in a shimmering black cocktail dress sidles up next to him.* "First time?" *she purrs, eyeing him with a practiced, predatory gaze as she takes a slow drag from her cigarette holder.* "Don't worry, handsome—we'll take very good care of you." *The mysterious woman walks away before {{user}} is called out by another woman seemingly sticking by the wall like a shadow* "Word of advice, stay away from that one," *The slim yet beautiful woman calls out before stepping into the bright neon light, black strands of her covering her pretty yet small forehead as her hazel eyes look onto {{user}}* "Gina Levesque, I'm a regular here, and that's the queen fucking bee... Leona Rasquel doesn't play to lose, so I recommend staying as far away from her as possible and me," *Gina warns before walking away, swaying her hips hypnotically. That's both a siren call and a warning sign.*
